drills.name: Knee-Hip-Feet Throwing Progression
drills.description: Pairs throw from one knee, then standing with hips only, then with full footwork, ten throws per phase at 10-15 yards.
drills.coachingPoints: Elbow above the shoulder, follow through to the opposite pocket.

drills.name: Three-Step Drop and Fire
drills.description: Quarterbacks take a snap, execute a three-step drop between cones, and deliver on time to a stationary target at a marked spot.
drills.coachingPoints: Big first step, ball high through the drop, throw the instant the back foot plants.

drills.name: Sprint-Out Throws
drills.description: Quarterback sprints laterally around a cone arc and throws on the move to a receiver running a matching flat route. Work both directions.
drills.coachingPoints: Square your shoulders to the target even while your feet keep moving.

drills.name: Route Tree on Air
drills.description: Receivers run the route tree one route at a time against no defense: slant, out, curl, post, go. Throw on every rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell every route like a go until the break, then snap it off sharp.

drills.name: Hands Catching Circuit
drills.description: Partners work five stations of ten catches each: high balls, low balls, over-the-shoulder, one-handed stabs, and rapid-fire short throws.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes to the tip of the ball, catch with your hands, then tuck.

drills.name: High-Point Fade Balls
drills.description: Receiver and defender jog side by side down the sideline; coach lofts a fade and both compete to catch it at its highest point. Switch roles each rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the ball at its peak. Go get it, don't wait for it.

drills.name: Release Ladder
drills.description: Receiver works a single-move release (foot fire, swipe, or speed release) against a partner shading press alignment, then bursts five yards upfield. Switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack their leverage foot and get their hands off you in one move.

drills.name: Gauntlet Ball Security
drills.description: Ball carrier runs a tight lane between two lines of teammates who punch, slap, and rip at the ball the whole way through.
drills.coachingPoints: Five points of pressure. Eagle claw, forearm, bicep, chest, high and tight.

drills.name: Cone Cut Reaction
drills.description: Ball carrier runs at a cone triangle; coach points left or right at the last second and the runner plants and cuts that way at full speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Plant the outside foot and get your shoulders downhill immediately.

drills.name: Handoff Exchange Circle
drills.description: Players jog a continuous circle exchanging one ball with proper mesh: quarterback seats the ball, runner forms the pocket, secures, and hands to the next.
drills.coachingPoints: Inside elbow up, eyes forward. Take the ball with your pocket, never your eyes.

drills.name: 2v1 Open Field
drills.description: Two ball carriers with one ball attack one defender in a 15-yard-wide alley; the runner uses the extra man, a cut, or speed to cross the line untouched.
drills.coachingPoints: Make one decisive move. Hesitation is what gets you caught in space.

drills.name: Fit and Freeze Form Tackle
drills.description: Partners walk through the tackle fit: leverage step, chest to thigh, head across, arms wrapped. Then freeze so the coach checks every position. No one goes to the ground.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes up, head across the body, hips low. See what you hit.

drills.name: Angle Pursuit to the Sideline
drills.description: Ball carrier runs a sideline path at three-quarter speed; defender starts inside and behind, sprinting an intercept angle to tag or two-hand touch before the cone.
drills.coachingPoints: Aim where they're going, not where they are.

drills.name: Bag Wrap and Drive
drills.description: Defender fits on a tackle bag, wraps, and drives it back five yards with churning feet while a partner braces it. Three reps, rotate.
drills.coachingPoints: Wrap and run your feet through contact. The tackle ends five yards later.

drills.name: Stance and Get-Off
drills.description: Linemen align in a three-point stance; on a varied cadence, everyone fires out three steps low and flat. Coach checks stance and first step every rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Flat back, weight balanced, explode on the sound. Not the guess.

drills.name: Mirror Punch Pass Pro
drills.description: Blocker kick-slides to mirror a partner's lateral rushes inside a five-yard lane, landing a two-hand punch to the chest plate each time the rusher closes.
drills.coachingPoints: Thumbs up, elbows in, punch on their move. Feet never cross.

drills.name: Drive Block on Bags
drills.description: Blocker fires from stance into a held blocking pad, strikes with hands inside, and drives it five yards on a straight line. Three reps, rotate holders.
drills.coachingPoints: Low pad wins. Strike up and through with your hips behind your hands.

drills.name: Sprint Ladder and Pro Agility
drills.description: Two stations: quick-feet patterns through an agility ladder, then the 5-10-5 pro agility shuttle between cones. Everyone cycles both twice.
drills.coachingPoints: Fast feet in the ladder, low hips and hand-touch the line in the shuttle.

drills.name: Play Execution on Air
drills.description: Full offense runs the install plays against no defense at full speed: break the huddle, align, execute assignments, finish ten yards downfield.
drills.coachingPoints: Perfect alignment and full-speed finish. Walkthrough pace teaches walkthrough habits.

drills.name: Situational 7-on-7
drills.description: Skill players run 7-on-7 with the coach calling down, distance, and clock before each snap. Third and long, red zone, two-minute drill.
drills.coachingPoints: Know the situation before the snap. The down and distance picks your decision for you.

drills.name: Wrist Flick Warm-Up
drills.description: Quarterbacks kneel facing a partner ten yards away and throw using only the wrist and fingers with the elbow held high. Fifteen throws before any full-motion work.
drills.coachingPoints: Index finger last off the ball. Tight spiral or you are pushing it.

drills.name: Hip Torque Throws
drills.description: Passer starts with his back foot turned away from the target, then throws by rotating the hips through before the arm comes. Twelve throws at fifteen yards.
drills.coachingPoints: Hips pull the arm, the arm doesn't pull the hips. Front shoulder to the target.

drills.name: Net Accuracy Grid
drills.description: Throw at four quadrants of a target net or between two cones hung on a fence, calling the quadrant before each throw. Twenty throws, tracking hits.
drills.coachingPoints: Aim at a jersey number, not a body. Same release point on every throw.

drills.name: Five-Step Drop and Hitch
drills.description: Quarterback works a five-step drop from under center, hitches once, and throws to a spot fifteen yards downfield. Eight reps, then eight from shotgun with a three-step timing.
drills.coachingPoints: Big, big, small, small, small. The hitch is the throw starting, not a pause.

drills.name: Drop Depth Cone Check
drills.description: Cones mark the exact landing spot for a three-, five-, and seven-step drop. Quarterback runs each drop and a coach checks whether his back foot lands on the cone. Six reps of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Depth is timing. Land on the spot and the route is already open.

drills.name: Reset Feet After the Scramble
drills.description: Quarterback drops, slides one direction to avoid a coach holding a bag, then resets his feet square to a new target before throwing. Eight reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Slide, don't run, until you have to. Feet square before the ball leaves.

drills.name: Rollout Both Directions
drills.description: Quarterback rolls right and throws on the run, then rolls left and does the same, hitting a receiver running a flat route. Six reps each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your shoulders around to the target. Rolling left, shorten the stride and throw over the top.

drills.name: Throw on the Run Ladder
drills.description: Quarterback runs a lateral path past three cones and throws to a stationary target at each one without stopping. Three passes per trip, four trips.
drills.coachingPoints: Shoulders and hips face the target even when the feet don't. Never throw across your body off the back foot.

drills.name: High-Low Read on Air
drills.description: Two receivers run a high route and a low route in the same zone with one coach playing the defender. Quarterback throws opposite whichever route the defender takes. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Read the defender, not the receiver. If he sinks, throw the flat.

drills.name: Man or Zone Presnap Call
drills.description: Defense lines up in either man or zone and the quarterback has to call which one out loud before the snap, then throw the route that beats it. Twelve snaps.
drills.coachingPoints: Safeties tell you the story. Two high, attack the middle. One high, work the edges.

drills.name: Coverage Rotation Reads
drills.description: Defense shows one coverage presnap and rotates to another after the snap. Quarterback must find the route that opens up after the rotation. Ten snaps, alternating rotations.
drills.coachingPoints: Take the presnap picture, then confirm it after the snap. Late rotation means a window opened somewhere else.

drills.name: Thumbs and Pinkies Catching
drills.description: Partner throws balls above the chest and below the waist in an alternating pattern from ten yards. Receiver catches thumbs together on the high ones and pinkies together on the low ones. Twenty catches.
drills.coachingPoints: High ball thumbs in, low ball pinkies in. Catch it out front where you can see it.

drills.name: Look It In Sideline Toe Taps
drills.description: Receiver runs along the sideline and catches passes thrown just inside the line, tapping both feet in bounds before falling out. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes stay on the ball until it's tucked, then find the line. Toes drag, don't stomp.

drills.name: Over-the-Shoulder Bucket Catches
drills.description: Receiver runs a straight line away from the thrower and catches a lofted ball over alternating shoulders without breaking stride. Six over each shoulder.
drills.coachingPoints: Little fingers together, catch it in a basket. Turn your head, not your whole body.

drills.name: Stem and Break Route Work
drills.description: Receiver runs the first five yards of every route identically, then breaks late into a curl, an out, or a slant on a coach's hand signal. Nine reps, three of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Every route looks the same for five yards. Sink your hips and break flat, don't round it.

drills.name: Depth and Landmark Routes
drills.description: Receiver runs a curl, a dig, and a comeback while a coach stands at the correct landmark for each and calls out whether the break happened early, late, or on time. Two reps of each route, three rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: The depth is the play. A yard short and the linebacker is standing in it.

drills.name: Speed Cut vs Sink Cut
drills.description: Receiver runs the same out route twice, once rounding it as a speed cut and once sinking the hips to break flat, so he feels the difference in separation. Eight reps alternating.
drills.coachingPoints: Drop your weight before you break, not during. The flat break is a yard of separation.

drills.name: Hands Away from the Body
drills.description: Defender jogs alongside with a hand in the receiver's chest while a ball is thrown slightly outside. Receiver must extend and catch away from the contact. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands out, elbows soft. Never let it get into your pads.

drills.name: Back Shoulder Adjust
drills.description: Quarterback deliberately throws behind the receiver on a go route and the receiver has to stop, turn back, and high point it. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Feel the throw late, then plant and come back. Shield him with your outside arm.

drills.name: Two-Man Ball Battle
drills.description: Coach lofts a ball between two players who both go up for it. Whoever does not catch it must immediately play defense and strip. Six reps per pairing.
drills.coachingPoints: Highest point, both hands, land with it tucked. If you can't catch it, nobody does.

drills.name: Press Release Hand Fighting
drills.description: Receiver works against a press defender using a swim, a rip, and a hesitation release on consecutive reps. Nine reps total, three of each move.
drills.coachingPoints: Get skinny and get off the line in two steps. Beat his hands before he gets them on you.

drills.name: Two-Way Go Releases
drills.description: Receiver lined up with space on both sides has to release the direction the defender does not take away, then stack him within five yards. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Take what he gives you, then get on top of him. Stack means his hip is behind yours.

drills.name: High and Tight Carry Checks
drills.description: Backs jog a twenty yard path while two coaches swipe at the ball from both sides. Any loose carry means the rep starts over. Four trips each.
drills.coachingPoints: Five points of pressure: fingers over the tip, ball on the ribs, elbow down. Never carry it like a loaf of bread.

drills.name: Switch Hands at the Cone
drills.description: Runner carries the ball in the outside arm, switches hands cleanly at a mid-path cone, and finishes with it in the new outside arm. Six trips.
drills.coachingPoints: Outside arm always, so the ball is away from the defender. Switch it in one motion against your chest.

drills.name: Ball Security on the Ground
drills.description: Runner is tripped or pushed off balance by a coach with a bag and must hit the ground with two hands on the ball. Eight reps, alternating which side he falls.
drills.coachingPoints: Two hands the second you feel yourself going down. The ground causes more fumbles than the hit.

drills.name: Read the Bag Gap
drills.description: Three bags on the ground form two gaps. A coach steps into one gap after the handoff and the back has to cut into the other one without slowing down. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Press the line, then cut off one foot. Decide by the time you reach the first bag.

drills.name: Jump Cut and Jab Cut
drills.description: Runner attacks a cone and executes a lateral jump cut on the first trip, then a hard plant-and-go jab cut on the second. Six of each, both directions.
drills.coachingPoints: One cut and get north. Two cuts and the safety already caught you.

drills.name: Pick a Color Vision Run
drills.description: Two coaches downfield hold different colored pinnies and one raises his the moment the back takes the handoff. Runner has to break away from that color. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes up as soon as the ball is tucked. See it early and you never have to make a hard cut.

drills.name: Mesh Point Timing
drills.description: Quarterback and back run the mesh at three different depths so the back learns to arrive at the same spot every time. Ten reps at each depth with no defense.
drills.coachingPoints: Back makes the pocket and the quarterback puts it there. Eyes downfield, feel the ball.

drills.name: Blind Exchange Reps
drills.description: Back runs the mesh with his eyes already downfield and never looks at the ball. Twelve reps at walk-through speed, then twelve at full speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Never look for it. Inside elbow up, outside elbow down, and let it come to you.

drills.name: Pitch and Toss Exchange
drills.description: Quarterback reverse pivots and pitches to a back running laterally, and they alternate short pitches and longer tosses. Eight reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Pitch it out in front so he runs onto it. Two hands on the catch, then tuck it away.

drills.name: One-on-One Open Grass
drills.description: Runner and a single defender in a ten yard wide alley. Runner tries to get past using a move, a stiff arm, or pure speed while the defender breaks down and forms up. Four reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Make him commit, then get vertical. Never run east and west in the open field.

drills.name: Stiff Arm and Finish
drills.description: Runner works past a coach holding a bag by extending the near arm into the pad, then finishes ten yards downfield at full speed. Six reps each arm.
drills.coachingPoints: Lock the elbow into the shoulder, not the helmet. Keep your legs driving through the contact.

drills.name: Sideline Escape Run
drills.description: Runner starts near the sideline with a defender in pursuit at an angle and must decide to cut back inside or race him to the corner. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: If his shoulders are square to the sideline, cut back. If he is still chasing, beat him to the edge.

drills.name: Stance Check and Fire Out
drills.description: Linemen set their stance, a coach checks weight distribution and staggered foot, then they fire out three yards on the snap count. Twelve reps with a stance check every third one.
drills.coachingPoints: Weight on the balls of the feet, not the hand. First step six inches, not a leap.

drills.name: Directional First Step
drills.description: Coach points left, right, or straight after the cadence and the lineman takes his first step that direction without standing up. Fifteen reps mixed.
drills.coachingPoints: Step with the playside foot first, every time. Flat back, eyes up on step one.

drills.name: Hands Inside the Frame
drills.description: Blocker fits his hands on a held pad with thumbs up inside the defender's breastplate, holds three seconds, and resets. Twelve fit reps before any movement is added.
drills.coachingPoints: Thumbs up, elbows in, hands inside the shoulders. Wide hands get you beat and get you flagged.

drills.name: Punch and Reset Ladder
drills.description: Blocker delivers a two-hand punch into a held pad, resets his hands, and punches again on the coach's count. Three sets of eight punches.
drills.coachingPoints: Punch from the hip, not from the ear. Reload quick, a blocked hand is a beaten hand.

drills.name: Fit and Drive Progression
drills.description: Start already fitted on a pad, drive five yards, then back up and do it again starting from a stance. Six fitted reps and six full reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Short choppy steps, never cross your feet. Roll the hips through on contact.

drills.name: Angle and Reach Blocks
drills.description: Blocker works a down block on an inside shade, then a reach block on an outside shade, using the pad holder as the defender. Six of each.
drills.coachingPoints: On the reach, get your head across his outside number. On the down block, take his hip away.

drills.name: Double Team to Second Level
drills.description: Two blockers work a combination block on one pad holder, then one climbs off to a second holder standing five yards back. Eight reps, alternating who climbs.
drills.coachingPoints: Hip to hip first, move him, then climb. Don't leave early or you leave your buddy alone.

drills.name: Kick Slide Mirror
drills.description: Pass blocker kick slides along a line while a partner mirrors as the rusher, no contact. Three trips of eight yards each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Inside foot anchors, outside foot slides. Never cross over and never turn your shoulders.

drills.name: Anchor Against the Bull
drills.description: Rusher bull rushes into a held pad and the blocker has to sink his hips and stop the charge without getting driven back into the pocket. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Drop the hips and widen the base. Stop the feet before you stop the hands.

drills.name: Protection Call and Slide
drills.description: Five linemen identify the front, call the protection out loud, and slide as a unit against a walk-through rush look. Ten reps with the front changing each time.
drills.coachingPoints: Center makes the call, everybody echoes it. Slide together or you leave a gap.

drills.name: Rip and Swim Off the Block
drills.description: Defender works a rip move on one rep and a swim move on the next against a blocker holding a pad, finishing past him each time. Six of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack half the man, not the whole man. Get skinny through the gap and keep your feet moving.

drills.name: Two-Hand Shed and Find
drills.description: Defender takes on a pad, locks out with both hands, then sheds to the side a coach points and pursues five yards. Eight reps alternating directions.
drills.coachingPoints: Lock out, see the ball, then shed. Never take on a block with your shoulders turned.

drills.name: Keep Outside Leverage
drills.description: Edge defender takes on a kick-out block and has to spill it or keep his outside arm free while a back runs to the sideline. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Outside arm and outside leg stay free. Squeeze it down, never get turned inside.

drills.name: Breakdown Fit on Air
drills.description: Defender approaches a standing partner, breaks down in a hitting position, and fits his near shoulder and wrapped arms without any contact or drive. Twelve reps, air level only.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes through the thigh pads, never down. Near foot, near shoulder, arms wrap.

drills.name: Shoulder Tackle on the Bag
drills.description: Defender strikes a held bag with the shoulder, wraps both arms, and squeezes without driving. Six reps each shoulder at bag level before any live work.
drills.coachingPoints: Hit with the shoulder, see what you hit. The head goes to the side, never through.

drills.name: Knee to Fit to Feet
drills.description: Three-stage progression on the same partner: fit from both knees, then from one knee, then from a standing breakdown. Six reps at each stage.
drills.coachingPoints: Same fit every stage, just more speed. If the head drops, back up a stage.

drills.name: Wrap and Squeeze Holds
drills.description: From a fitted position on a bag, the defender wraps, squeezes, and holds for a three count with his feet still driving in place. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Grab cloth and squeeze, don't just touch. Feet keep chopping the whole time.

drills.name: Drive Through to the Ground
drills.description: Defender fits on a bag held by a coach, wraps, and drives it five yards before the coach lowers it to the ground. Six reps each side, control level.
drills.coachingPoints: Run your feet through him, don't lunge at him. Finish on top with your head free.

drills.name: Profile Tackle from the Side
drills.description: Ball carrier runs a straight line past the defender, who approaches from the side and takes a tracking angle to wrap the near hip. Six reps each side at control speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Track the near hip, not the numbers. Shoulder on, arms around, roll him to the sideline.

drills.name: Sideline Leverage Angles
drills.description: Ball carrier runs toward the sideline from twenty yards and the defender takes a path to cut him off, using the sideline as a twelfth defender. Six reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Aim where he will be, not where he is. Keep your outside shoulder free.

drills.name: Backside Pursuit Lanes
drills.description: Whole defense runs to the ball on a called play with each level staying in its pursuit lane. Coach stops it and everyone freezes so lanes can be checked. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Nobody runs the same path. Stay a body wide of the man inside you.

drills.name: Two-Yard Alley Breakdown
drills.description: Cones make a two yard alley so the runner has almost nowhere to go. Defender breaks down, closes, and makes a controlled wrap tackle. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Close the space fast, then chop your feet. Short, choppy steps beat one big lunge.

drills.name: Ten-Yard Space Tackle
drills.description: One defender, one runner, ten yards of grass and a five yard wide lane. Runner gets one move and the defender has to break down and finish. Four reps each at thud level.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your shoulders square and let him come to you. Take away one side and live with the other.

drills.name: Two-Man Gang Tackle
drills.description: Two defenders approach from different angles, the first wraps high on the ball and the second takes the legs. Six reps at control speed.
drills.coachingPoints: First man squares him up and attacks the ball. Second man runs through the hip.

drills.name: Ten-Yard Starts
drills.description: Players explode ten yards out of a three-point stance on a coach's movement cue. Eight reps with full walk-back recovery.
drills.coachingPoints: First three steps low and violent. Drive the arms, don't pop straight up.

drills.name: Forty Build-Ups
drills.description: Players run forty yards building from a jog to full speed over the first twenty, then holding top speed for the last twenty. Five reps with ninety seconds between.
drills.coachingPoints: Relax the jaw and the hands at top speed. Tension slows you down.

drills.name: Resisted Partner Starts
drills.description: One player holds a towel or belt around a partner's waist and provides light resistance for the first five yards, then releases. Six reps each, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Lean into it, don't bend at the waist. Punch the ground behind you.

drills.name: Ladder Footwork Series
drills.description: Four patterns through an agility ladder: one foot in each, two feet in each, lateral shuffle, and in-in-out-out. Two trips through each pattern.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of the feet, eyes up. Speed comes after the pattern is clean.

drills.name: W Drill Change of Direction
drills.description: Five cones in a W pattern. Players sprint forward and backpedal at each turn, staying square through every change. Four trips with rest between.
drills.coachingPoints: Drop the hips at the cone, don't round the corner. Never turn your shoulders to backpedal.

drills.name: Mirror Bag Reaction
drills.description: Two players face off across a line of bags, one leading with lateral movement and the other mirroring for twenty seconds. Four rounds each as leader.
drills.coachingPoints: React off his hips. Feet never cross, never stop.

drills.name: Broad Jump to Sprint
drills.description: Player does two standing broad jumps, sticks the second landing, then immediately sprints ten yards. Six reps with full recovery.
drills.coachingPoints: Swing the arms and land soft with bent knees. Jump out, not up.

drills.name: Bag Hop and Go
drills.description: Players hop over five bags two feet at a time, then sprint fifteen yards on landing. Six reps, alternating forward hops and lateral hops.
drills.coachingPoints: Quiet feet over the bags. The sprint starts the second you clear the last one.

drills.name: Bodyweight Power Circuit
drills.description: Four stations at thirty seconds each: squat jumps, push-ups, split squat jumps, and plank holds. Two rounds with a minute between.
drills.coachingPoints: Land soft and reset between jumps. Stop the set when the landings get loud.

drills.name: Gassers Sideline to Sideline
drills.description: Players run across the field and back twice for one gasser, on a time standard set for the age group. Four gassers with a full rest between.
drills.coachingPoints: Touch every line. Finish through the line, not at it.

drills.name: Perfect Play Tempo Drive
drills.description: Offense runs twelve plays in a row on air with a fifteen second clock between snaps, restarting the count on any missed assignment. One full drive.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint to the ball and get set. Conditioning and execution are the same rep here.

drills.name: Walk-Through Assignment Check
drills.description: Offense lines up and walks through five plays at half speed while a coach stops each one and asks two players to state their assignment out loud. Three rounds through the play list.
drills.coachingPoints: Know your job before the snap, not after. Say it out loud until you don't have to.

drills.name: Huddle to Snap Under Fifteen
drills.description: Full unit practices breaking the huddle, lining up, and snapping the ball inside fifteen seconds. Ten reps with a coach calling out the time on each one.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint to your spot, then get your eyes to the ball. Late to the line is a penalty waiting to happen.

drills.name: Cadence and Snap Count Discipline
drills.description: Offense runs the cadence with the coach occasionally using a hard count. Anyone who moves early owes the group five yards. Fifteen cadences with three hard counts mixed in.
drills.coachingPoints: Move on the ball, not on the sound. Defense, watch the ball. Offense, hear the call.

drills.name: Third and Short Package
drills.description: Offense gets three plays from their short yardage package with the defense knowing it is coming. Run each play twice from the two yard line and the five.
drills.coachingPoints: Low pads win short yardage. Get vertical, don't dance for a better hole.

drills.name: Two-Minute Drill
drills.description: Offense starts on its own forty with ninety seconds and one timeout, working the sideline and the clock. Run it twice, once needing a field goal and once needing a touchdown.
drills.coachingPoints: Get out of bounds or get down. Everyone sprints to the line, nobody celebrates.

drills.name: Backed Up Inside the Ten
drills.description: Offense starts on its own three yard line and has to get one first down without a safety or a turnover. Six snaps, then switch units.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball security first, yardage second. Quarterback, throw it away rather than take the sack.

drills.name: Red Zone Compressed Field
drills.description: Offense works from the fifteen yard line where the field shrinks and throwing windows close. Run six plays, three runs and three passes, against a live look.
drills.coachingPoints: No room behind the defense down here. Routes break flat and the back hits it downhill.

drills.name: Defensive Front Calls
drills.description: Defense identifies the formation, calls the strength, and makes its front and coverage call out loud before the snap. Twelve looks with the offense shifting on half of them.
drills.coachingPoints: Strength call first, everybody echoes it. A shift means you call it again.

drills.name: Sideline Signal Recognition
drills.description: Coach signals plays from the sideline and the whole unit has to line up correctly with no verbal huddle. Fifteen signals, increasing the tempo each round.
drills.coachingPoints: Eyes to the sideline the second the whistle blows. Repeat the signal to the man next to you.

drills.name: Kickoff Coverage Lanes
drills.description: Coverage team sprints downfield staying in their lanes and squeezes the returner toward the sideline. Six reps at controlled speed with a coach freezing the lanes mid-run.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay in your lane, don't chase the ball. Outside men keep everything inside them.

drills.name: Punt Protect and Release
drills.description: Punt unit holds its protection for a two count, then releases in coverage. Eight reps with the snap, catch, and kick timed by a coach.
drills.coachingPoints: Protect first, cover second. Nobody leaves until the ball is off the foot.

drills.name: Return Wall Setup
drills.description: Return team catches the kick and sets a wall down one sideline while the returner reads it. Six reps to each side with no live contact.
drills.coachingPoints: Get to your landmark before you look for someone to block. Returner runs to the wall, not away from it.

drills.name: Field Goal Operation Timing
drills.description: Snapper, holder, and kicker run the full operation on a clock, aiming for the ball to be off the ground inside one and a third seconds. Twelve reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Laces out, same spot every time. The operation is the kick, not the leg.
